video_title: Why 2020 Lakers Need to be Respected (ft. Danny Green)

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers faced immense pressure to win the 2020 championship
quotes.excerpt: Everybody's critiquing you from the major media to the small market media to people with fake accounts.
quotes.quote: As a Laker, with that magnifying glass and that microscope on us throughout the whole year, it brought a lot of heat and a lot of attention. And being the number one seed and all the guys that we signed, you're expected to win. You're expected to do it. Everybody's critiquing you from the major media to the small market media to people with fake accounts.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant's death added significant pressure to the Lakers' season
quotes.excerpt: There was definitely added pressure following Kobe's death.
quotes.quote: There was definitely a huge amount of pressure, but added pressure following Kobe's death. And then, of course, when they brought in the Mamba jerseys and wearing that Mamba jersey, it was sleek, it was nice. It was one of my favorite jerseys of all time. Fire jersey, but it came with a little bit of extra pressure on top.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers-Clippers rivalry was at its peak in the bubble
quotes.excerpt: This is where the rivalry was like at its peak.
quotes.quote: Clippers were really good that year. This is where the rivalry was like at its peak. This is the matchup that everybody wanted, right? In the playoffs, we never got it.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Media pressure during the playoffs was a wake-up call
quotes.excerpt: When you win, you're the best in the world. When you lose, it's like, oh, they're in trouble.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say it was a panic, but you know how the media is. When you win, you're the best in the world. When you lose, it's like, oh, they're in trouble. They might be going home. And I remember that happening in the Portland series. I remember that happening in the Houston series. That was a wake-up call.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis was a dominant force during the 2020 playoffs
quotes.excerpt: This is pre-healthy Anthony Davis. This is what got him top 75.
quotes.quote: This is pre-healthy Anthony Davis. This is what got him top 75. That was a top 75 player in the history of the game because of what he's capable of, what he could do, and what he did.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' leadership was a defining factor for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: He is a true definition of an all aspects of the sense of a leader.
quotes.quote: You would think he was a guy that went to college because he operated in his organization like he was a true leader. And I can say that because I've been through multiple organizations and I've seen some really good ones and I've seen some bad ones. And he is a true definition of an all aspects of the sense of a leader.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajon Rondo's playoff performance was crucial for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: The biggest best players in the world shine when the stage and the lights are the brightest.
quotes.quote: The biggest best players in the world shine when the stage and the lights are the brightest. And he's an example of that. He knows every play the other team is running. He's going to watch film, watch the game three times, and tell us what he saw.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajon Rondo's Boston background shaped his competitive trash-talking nature
quotes.excerpt: He grew up in that Boston culture where it's from that era where MJ used to talk trash.
quotes.quote: He grew up in that Boston culture where it's from that era where MJ used to talk trash to himself to like, well I took that personal. It's like that guy never said that. You just made that up in your mind. KG, I think used to talk to himself. Rondo, he didn't need anybody else to get him up for like, he was just a trash talker and a lot of times to himself to get himself going.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray were a formidable threat in the bubble
quotes.excerpt: Jokic was still a very good player, but he wasn't three-time MVP Jokic at this point.
quotes.quote: Jokic was still a very good player, but he wasn't three-time MVP Jokic at this point. And Jamal Murray was just bubble Murray was on another level, too.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's bubble performance was impressive despite the coffee prices
quotes.excerpt: Jimmy's cool. I think he's great. I'm a fan. I'm not that much of a fan.
quotes.quote: I'm not a coffee person, but even if I was, I'm not paying $20. I think it was like $40 for like he was charging like $40 a coffee cup. Yeah, I'm cool. Jimmy's cool. I think he's great. I'm a fan. I'm not that much of a fan.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler transforms into a different player during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I feel like he's one of those guys that again, like Rondo, turns into a different player.
quotes.quote: I feel like he's one of those guys that again, like Rondo, turns into a different player when the playoffs start. Like he's a guy during a regular season, it's like, all right, we can guard him to where you know, make him shoot jump shots. You can't do that in the playoffs against Jimmy.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: The final play in Game 5 remains a blur
quotes.excerpt: When you have a play like this happen, you don't remember anything but this play.
quotes.quote: I don't remember much of how it began. When you have a play like this happen, you don't remember anything but this play.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Missing the final shot was a character-building experience
quotes.excerpt: There's been plenty of shots I've been a part of that were big moments.
quotes.quote: There's been plenty of shots I've been a part of that were big moments, and I've made some and I missed some. That was one of them. It's unfortunate, but it helped build character within me and within us.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: The 2020 championship was the hardest to achieve
quotes.excerpt: It was by far the hardest championship that I had to achieve.
quotes.quote: It was by far the hardest championship that I had to achieve. Said making that adjustment playing through COVID, having your family and friends not really there, not be able to even celebrate it properly. We went to the same restaurant that we go to every day and celebrated as a team, but after that no road parade. So it was it was just different.
